1. Enterprise SA Selection Decision Tree (R586)
Persistent Cloud Transfer TUI, iCloud Backup, Camera Calibration & Browser CLI
Q1: Disconnect-Proof Dual-Pane rclone TUI across 40+ Clouds?
• SyscallBrain/ratclone (★32, MIT, Rust Ratatui):
Talks to rclone rcd daemon over HTTP (127.0.0.1:5572)
Transfers survive TUI quit or SSH drop; reconnects to live jobs
• Vim keys (j/k/h/l, Space multi-select, c/m/s/d) + 5 themes
Q2: Read-Only Windows iCloud Photos Full + Compact Archive?
• ClaudeIvanovich/iCloud-Photo-Downloader (★37, MIT, Python):
Strictly read-only iCloud fetch; organizes YYYY\MM Month\
Dual Full size + Compact (Pillow/ffmpeg/pillow-heif HEIC->JPG)
• Windows Credential Manager keyring + 2FA/2SA + 6 UI languages
Q3: Automated In-Camera Nikon .NP3 Film-Look Calibration?
• gerard662/nikon-picture-control-matcher (★33, MIT, Python):
Color-chart solver driving Nikon NX Studio CLI (NXStudioCli)
Optimizes tone curve, 8-band HSL, sharpening & Color Blender
• Exports versioned PICCONnn.NP3 directly to Nikon Z SD card
Q4: Hardened Browser-Session CLI for Gemini & Messaging?
• amadshobi/opencli-plugins (★19, MIT, JavaScript):
14 commands across AI Studio, Gemini, Telegram & WhatsApp Web
Fail-fast rate-limit detection + download-race guard + byte check
• Reuses authenticated browser cookies without fragile scraping
2. End-to-End Enterprise Media Asset Sync, Camera Calibration & Browser-CLI Architecture
Four-Pillar Pipeline: Persistent rclone rcd TUI ➔ Read-Only iCloud Ingest ➔ NX Studio .NP3 Solver ➔ Verified Browser CLI
Pillar A: Persistent Multi-Cloud TUI (SyscallBrain/ratclone)
• Daemon-Decoupled Design: Spawns or attaches to rclone rcd
• Zero-Drop Transfers: Quitting TUI or losing SSH leaves rcd
transfers running; relaunching ratclone re-attaches live bars
• Dual-Pane Vim Navigation: Independent local/remote panes,
Space multi-select, copy (c), move (m), sync (s), delete (d)
• Telemetry: Per-file speed, byte progress, ETA & 5 themes
• Scope: Works across S3, GCS, Azure Blob, OneDrive, GDrive
✓ Eliminates tmux/nohup babysitting for multi-TB cloud migrations
Pillar B: Read-Only iCloud Archive (iCloud-Photo-Downloader)
• Safety Invariant: 100% read-only against iCloud CloudKit API
• Structured Hierarchy: YYYY\MM Month\Full size & Compact
• Dual-Tier Compression: Pillow JPEG resize (70% quality, EXIF
preserved), ffmpeg video transcode & pillow-heif HEIC-to-JPG
• Security: Windows Credential Manager keyring + 2FA/2SA dialog
• Resilience: Auto-reconnect on network drop + skip existing files
• Localization: EN, ES, PT, FR, DE, RU Tkinter GUI + CLI flags
✓ Prevents accidental iCloud sync deletion during local archival
Pillar C: In-Camera .NP3 Solver (nikon-picture-control-matcher)
• Hardware-Authentic Loop: Drives real Nikon NX Studio CLI
• 24-Patch Color Chart Alignment: Compares Nikon .NEF RAW vs
target camera JPEG (e.g. Fujifilm X100VI Astia / Film Sims)
• Multi-Stage Optimization: Tone curve control points, 8-band
HSL Hue/Chroma/Brightness, Color Blender & sharpening
• SD Card Delivery: Writes versioned PICCON01.NP3..PICCON99.NP3
for zero-post-processing straight-out-of-camera (SOOC) JPEGs
✓ Eliminates Lightroom post-grading for multi-camera shoots
Pillar D: Hardened Browser CLI (amadshobi/opencli-plugins)
• 4 Platforms / 14 Commands: Google AI Studio, Gemini App,
Telegram Web (contacts/chats/history/send) & WhatsApp Web
• Production Gemini Image Hardening:
1) Pre-flight + mid-generation rate-limit fail-fast detection
2) Download-race protection across concurrent generations
3) Non-zero byte-size file verification before returning JSON
• Session Reuse: Bridges existing authenticated Chrome tabs
✓ Prevents silent 0-byte downloads & hanging browser timeouts
